items.title: Hridoy joins Shakib-Mushfiq's elite list with double ton
items.summary: The 24-year-old also joined an elite list of Bangladesh batters to score first-class double centuries abroad, alongside Mushfiqur Rahim and Shakib Al Hasan.

items.title: Khaled links up with Hasan at Kent for County Championship
items.summary: Kent Cricket on Tuesday confirmed the signing of Bangladesh pacer Khaled Ahmed for September’s Rothesay County Championship fixtures, subject to regulatory approval.

items.title: BCB suspends former director, two others over BPL fixing
items.summary: The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) on Tuesday suspended former board director Muhammad Mukhlesur Rahman Shamim and two others over fixing-related issues during the 12th edition of the Bangladesh Premier League (BPL) T20.
